questions.explanation:
Given z = x + iy

and

(x + iy)2 = i(x2 + y2)

x2 - y2 + 2ixy = i(x2 + y2) + 0

Comparing both side we get,

x2 - y2 = 0

x2 = y2

and 2xy = (x2 + y2)

(x - y)2 = 0

x = y

z lies on line x = y
